title: Cold & Dark Startup
disclaimer: For Aerofly FS 4 learning only. Not for real-world flight training or operations.

sources.title: Aerofly A320 Flight Tutorial — Cockpit Preparation through Engine Start

steps.title: Safety checks
steps.instruction: Confirm wipers and weather radar are OFF. Landing gear lever DOWN. Both ENG MASTER switches OFF. Engine mode selector NORMAL.
steps.purpose: Avoid unintended system activation when electrical power comes online.

location.section: Lights, radar, landing gear, engine controls
location.hint: Scan overhead weather radar and wipers, then pedestal engine masters and gear lever.

steps.title: Battery voltage
steps.instruction: Check battery voltage is greater than 25.5V before turning the batteries on.
steps.purpose: Batteries must have enough charge to power essential DC buses and start the APU.

location.hint: Top-left overhead electrical panel / ECAM ELEC when powered.

notes: If voltage is low, use external power first when AVAIL.

steps.title: BAT 1 → ON
steps.instruction: Push the BAT 1 pushbutton to ON.
steps.purpose: Provides DC electrical power from battery 1.

location.hint: Top-left of the overhead electrical panel.

steps.title: BAT 2 → ON
steps.instruction: Push the BAT 2 pushbutton to ON.
steps.purpose: Provides DC electrical power from battery 2; together the batteries give basic DC power for APU start.

location.hint: Next to BAT 1 on the overhead electrical panel.

steps.title: External power
steps.instruction: When the EXT PWR pushbutton shows green AVAIL, push it to connect external AC power.
steps.purpose: Powers the flight-deck screens from ground power without running the APU yet.

location.hint: EXT PWR pushbutton on the electrical panel.

steps.condition: Only if EXT PWR shows green AVAIL.

steps.title: APU fire test
steps.instruction: Push and hold the APU fire TEST pushbutton on the upper overhead, then release.
steps.purpose: Confirms APU fire detection and extinguishing indications work before APU start.

location.hint: Upper part of the overhead panel.

expectedResult: Red ECAM master warning / APU FIRE action while held

steps.title: APU MASTER → ON
steps.instruction: Push the APU MASTER SW pushbutton ON.
steps.purpose: Powers APU computers and begins the APU self-test / inlet door sequence.

location.hint: APU panel on the overhead.

steps.title: Wait for APU ready to start
steps.instruction: Wait a few seconds for the APU self-test to finish and the inlet door to open. Monitor the APU page on the lower ECAM.
steps.purpose: Starting too early fails; the inlet must be open before START.

location.hint: Lower ECAM — select the APU page if needed.

expectedResult: APU inlet door open on ECAM APU page

steps.title: APU START
steps.instruction: Push the APU START pushbutton.
steps.purpose: Spools the APU so it can supply electrical power and bleed air on the ground.

location.hint: APU START next to APU MASTER.

expectedResult: Upper ECAM shows APU AVAIL memo

steps.title: APU BLEED → ON
steps.instruction: Turn on APU BLEED once the APU shows AVAIL.
steps.purpose: Provides bleed air for packs and for engine start.

location.hint: APU BLEED pushbutton on the air panel.

steps.title: PACK 1 & PACK 2 → ON
steps.instruction: Confirm PACK 1 and PACK 2 are turned on.
steps.purpose: Air conditioning packs cool and pressurize the cabin using APU bleed.

location.hint: PACK 1 and PACK 2 pushbuttons.

steps.title: Fuel pumps → ON
steps.instruction: Turn on all fuel pumps: L TK PUMP 1 and 2, CTR TK 1 and 2, R TK PUMP 1 and 2.
steps.purpose: Delivers fuel to the engines and APU for start and operation.

location.hint: Fuel pump row across the overhead fuel panel.

steps.title: Overhead lights check
steps.instruction: Check that no unexpected white lights remain on the overhead panel.
steps.purpose: White lights usually mean a system is not in the normal configuration.

location.hint: Scan the entire overhead for white pushbutton lights.

steps.title: ADIRS → NAV
steps.instruction: Set all three ADIRS switches to the NAV position.
steps.purpose: Starts IRS alignment so navigation and flight displays have valid attitude and position.

location.hint: Three ADIRS rotary switches on the overhead.

expectedResult: Alignment completes in about one minute in Aerofly
notes: Real-world alignment can take 10+ minutes; Aerofly speeds this to about one minute.

steps.title: NAV & LOGO → 1
steps.instruction: Place the NAV & LOGO light switch to position 1.
steps.purpose: Turns on the first set of navigation and logo lights for ground operations.

location.hint: NAV & LOGO rotary on the lights panel.

steps.title: EMER EXIT LT → ARM
steps.instruction: Set EMER EXIT LT to the center ARM position.
steps.purpose: Arms passenger emergency exit lighting for the flight.

location.hint: EMER EXIT LT switch — center detent is ARM.

steps.title: SEAT BELTS & NO SMOKING → AUTO
steps.instruction: Set SEAT BELTS and NO SMOKING switches to AUTO.
steps.purpose: Automates cabin signs; in Aerofly the no-smoking switch also signals PED use.

location.hint: Seat belts and no smoking switches near the emergency exit light switch.

steps.title: Engine fire tests
steps.instruction: Press and hold ENG 1 fire TEST, then repeat for ENG 2. Release after each test.
steps.purpose: Confirms engine fire warning and extinguisher indications.

location.hint: Upper overhead ENG 1 / ENG 2 fire TEST buttons.

expectedResult: Master warning and ECAM FIRE messages while held

steps.title: Flaps, spoilers, parking brake
steps.instruction: Confirm flap lever at the indicated position, speed brake retracted, parking brake ON, and brake accumulator pressure sufficient.
steps.purpose: Aircraft is configured and held for engine start.

location.hint: Center pedestal levers and parking brake handle; check brake pressure gauge.

expectedResult: Parking brake on with adequate accumulator pressure

steps.title: ECAM system quantities
steps.instruction: On ECAM, check engine oil, hydraulic oil, oxygen pressure, and STATUS. Press RCL to show previous cautions if needed.
steps.purpose: Catch low fluid or oxygen before departure.

location.hint: Use ECAM page buttons on the center panel.

expectedResult: Oil, hydraulic, and oxygen quantities acceptable

steps.title: MCDU INIT B masses
steps.instruction: On the MCDU INIT B page, enter ZFW, ZFWCG, and BLOCK fuel.
steps.purpose: Gives the FMGC correct weight data for performance and predictions.

location.hint: Captain or FO MCDU — INIT page, then INIT B.

notes: A full MCDU preflight is covered in Aerofly’s A320 MCDU tutorial; this step is the minimum for startup.

steps.title: MCDU takeoff performance
steps.instruction: On the takeoff performance page, enter V1, VR, V2, and takeoff flaps.
steps.purpose: Sets takeoff speeds and configuration the aircraft will use on the roll.

location.hint: MCDU PERF page for takeoff.

steps.title: BEACON → ON
steps.instruction: Set the BEACON light switch to ON.
steps.purpose: Signals that engines may be started; required before engine start.

location.hint: BEACON switch on the lights panel.

steps.title: Default ECAM page
steps.instruction: Return to the default ECAM page (press the selected page button again or CLR if highlighted green).
steps.purpose: Clears manual page selections so engine-start pages can appear automatically.

location.hint: Center pedestal ECAM control panel.

steps.title: Pumps, APU, bleed confirm
steps.instruction: Confirm all fuel pumps are on, APU is running, and APU BLEED is on.
steps.purpose: Engine start needs fuel and APU bleed air.

location.hint: Quick overhead and ECAM memo scan.

steps.title: Doors closed
steps.instruction: Open the ECAM DOORS page. Click any doors still open; wait until labels go from amber to white (closed / slide armed).
steps.purpose: Aircraft must be closed and slides armed before taxi and takeoff.

location.hint: ECAM DOORS page — click open door labels in Aerofly.

steps.title: Flight directors → ON
steps.instruction: Push F/D on the captain and first officer sides until each shows a green highlight.
steps.purpose: Enables flight director guidance on both PFDs for departure.

location.hint: F/D buttons left and right of the FCU.

steps.title: Set FCU altitude
steps.instruction: Rotate the FCU altitude selector to your initial climb / cruise altitude (tutorial example: 35000 ft).
steps.purpose: Arms the altitude target the autopilot will capture after takeoff.

location.hint: Center glareshield FCU altitude selector.

expectedResult: FCU shows managed speed/heading dashes when pushed as needed

steps.title: ENG MODE → IGN/START
steps.instruction: Set the engine mode selector to IGN/START.
steps.purpose: Arms ignition and start valves for FADEC automatic engine start.

location.hint: Engine mode rotary behind the thrust levers.

steps.title: ENG 2 MASTER → ON
steps.instruction: Move the ENG 2 master switch from OFF to ON. Start the right engine first.
steps.purpose: Commands FADEC to start engine 2 automatically.

location.hint: ENG 2 master switch on the pedestal.

expectedResult: N2/N1 rising, FF and EGT increasing
Green AVAIL above ENG 2 N1 when started

steps.title: ENG 1 MASTER → ON
steps.instruction: When ENG 2 shows AVAIL, move the ENG 1 master switch from OFF to ON.
steps.purpose: Starts the left engine the same way.

location.hint: ENG 1 master switch on the pedestal.

steps.title: ENG MODE → NORMAL
steps.instruction: When both engines show AVAIL, set the engine mode selector back to NORMAL.
steps.purpose: Returns ignition/start logic to normal flight operation.

location.hint: Same rotary used for IGN/START.

steps.title: Arm ground spoilers
steps.instruction: Pull the speed brake lever forward until the white stripe appears (or tap the lever briefly).
steps.purpose: Arms ground spoilers for rejected takeoff and landing.

location.hint: Speed brake lever on the pedestal.

steps.title: Flaps → takeoff
steps.instruction: Set flaps to the takeoff position (tutorial example: flaps 1). ECAM should show 1+F.
steps.purpose: Configures the wing for takeoff.

location.hint: Flap lever on the right side of the pedestal.

expectedResult: ECAM shows 1+F (or your planned takeoff flap)

steps.title: Rudder & pitch trim
steps.instruction: Center rudder trim with the reset button. Set pitch trim to the takeoff value (tutorial example: UP 0.0).
steps.purpose: Neutralizes trim for a stable takeoff rotation.

location.hint: Rudder trim switch/reset and pitch trim wheel/indicator.

steps.title: PWS and transponder
steps.instruction: Turn on predictive wind shear (PWS) on the weather radar panel. Set the transponder to TA/RA.
steps.purpose: Enables wind-shear alerting and TCAS for the flight.

location.hint: Weather radar panel for PWS; transponder panel for TA/RA.

steps.title: APU BLEED → OFF
steps.instruction: Push APU BLEED off now that engines can supply bleed air.
steps.purpose: Transfers bleed source from APU to the engines.

location.hint: APU BLEED pushbutton.

steps.title: APU MASTER → OFF
steps.instruction: Push APU MASTER off. Allow the APU cooldown, then it will spool down.
steps.purpose: Shuts down the APU once engines are providing power and bleed.

location.hint: APU MASTER SW.

steps.title: External power off
steps.instruction: If external power is still connected, turn EXT PWR off.
steps.purpose: Disconnects ground power now that engine generators are online.

location.hint: EXT PWR pushbutton.

steps.condition: Only if external power is still in use.

steps.title: ECAM RCL / STATUS
steps.instruction: Push ECAM RCL and review the STATUS page.
steps.purpose: Surfaces any remaining cautions before taxi.

location.hint: ECAM RCL button, then STATUS page.

steps.title: Sidestick full forward / aft
steps.instruction: Push the sidestick fully forward, then fully aft. Watch the PFD crosshair and ECAM F/CTL page.
steps.purpose: Confirms elevator response before taxi.

location.hint: Deflecting controls auto-opens the F/CTL ECAM page.

expectedResult: PFD crosshair moves full down / up

steps.title: Sidestick full left / right
steps.instruction: Move the sidestick full left, then full right.
steps.purpose: Confirms aileron and roll spoiler response.

location.hint: Watch ailerons and green spoiler arrows on F/CTL.

expectedResult: Ailerons and roll spoilers deflect correctly

steps.title: Rudder full left / right
steps.instruction: Apply full left then full right rudder. If taxiing, hold the tiller pedal disconnect to disable nose-wheel steering during the test.
steps.purpose: Confirms rudder authority before departure.

location.hint: Watch rudder deflection on the F/CTL page.

expectedResult: Rudder full travel on ECAM F/CTL
